newsitem.title: USA: Cold Metal sees Q4 EPS $0.04-$0.07.
newsitem.headline: Cold Metal sees Q4 EPS $0.04-$0.07.

text.p: Cold Metal Products Inc said Friday it expects fiscal fourth quarter earnings per share of $0.04 to $0.07 after a charge and other costs.

The company said its expects a charge of $0.09 to $0.10 a share related to its exit from its unprofitable East Coast steel brokerage business, and previously announced costs related to the startup of its new rolling facility in Ottawa, Ohio.

The company said the East Coast brokerage segment, which involved the purchase and resale of commodity sheet coils, has been unprofitable over the past two years. It said it expects to effect a fourth quarter after-tax writedown of $650,000 to $700,000, or $0.09 to $0.10 per share, as it exits this business.

In January, Cold Metals announced that its new Ottawa facility would incur additional startup costs in the fourth quarter and that these costs were estimated at $800,000 to $900,000 after-tax, or $0.11-$0.13 per share. These costs are included in the fourth quarter earnings projection of $0.04-$0.07 a share, the company said.
It said it expects the facility to operate below the break-even level during the first quarter of fiscal 1998.
Analysts on average expect fourth quarter earnings of $0.08 per share, according to First Call.
The company earned $0.19 per share in the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996.
Results for the fourth quarter and the full year are expected to be announced in mid-May, the company said.
